item.title: RoundSignal 2026-W32: 10 freshly-funded accounts to sell to this week
item.description:
RoundSignal Issue 2026-W32

Freshly-funded B2B SaaS & tech startups (pre-seed -> Series B)

10 trigger-ready accounts, scored and contextualized.

inforcer

heat 90

Trigger: $50M Series C led by Insight Partners (Meritech, Dawn Capital participating) - Tech.eu, as of 30 Jul 2026

Why now: UK B2B SaaS scaling an AI security platform for MSPs just raised a large Series C; they will be hiring and building out GTM, security, and partner programs fast - ideal window for RevOps, growth, and recruiting services.

Who to contact: VP Marketing / Head of Revenue Operations

Angle: Congrats on the Insight-led Series C - most MSP-focused platforms hit a channel-scaling wall right after; I've helped B2B security vendors stand up partner-led RevOps in under 60 days, happy to share a quick playbook.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 31 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

Intropy

heat 88

Trigger: €9.5M / $11M Seed led by Felix Capital (Quiet Capital, General Catalyst, firstminute) - EU-Startups & Tech.eu, as of 30 Jul 2026

Why now: London AI-native platform for the spare parts industry just closed a sizable seed and is explicitly targeting US expansion; corroborated across two outlets, so demand for growth, brand, and US-market services is imminent.

Who to contact: Co-founder & CEO (Franziska Kirschner) / Head of Growth

Angle: Saw Felix Capital backed your spare-parts OS and that US expansion is next - I help European seed-stage SaaS localize positioning and demand-gen for the US launch; want a teardown of your current messaging?

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 31 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

Centralize

heat 85

Trigger: $15M Series A (emerging from stealth), founded by former Meta and Slack engineers - Crunchbase News, as of 29 Jul 2026

Why now: Just out of stealth with a Series A for an enterprise sales 'Deal GPS' platform; post-launch they need brand, content, demand-gen, and RevOps talent immediately - a hot 48h window.

Who to contact: Co-founder / CEO or Head of Marketing

Angle: Congrats on decloaking with the $15M round - launching a GTM tool means your own GTM has to be flawless; I've run launch demand-gen for enterprise sales startups and can share a 30-day plan.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 31 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

Atomic One

heat 78

Trigger: €5.6M two-tranche round (Arcano Partners / Impacto Andalucía) - EU-Startups, as of 31 Jul 2026

Why now: Málaga-based AI operating system for e-commerce brands just closed multi-million funding; freshly-funded and scaling means openings for growth, design, and RevOps service providers.

Who to contact: CEO / Head of Growth

Angle: Congrats on the €5.6M raise - AI-for-ecommerce companies usually need to prove ROI fast to their first cohort of brands; I help early SaaS build case-study-driven growth engines, worth a chat?

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 31 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

Freehand

heat 77

Trigger: $75M Series B to automate Fortune 500 supply chain spend - Crunchbase News, as of 29 Jul 2026

Why now: Large Series B for an enterprise AI agent platform; they'll be aggressively hiring and expanding enterprise GTM - strong fit for recruiting, RevOps, and fractional CFO/CMO services.

Who to contact: VP Revenue / Head of Talent

Angle: A $75M Series B means a hiring and GTM sprint - I place fractional RevOps/CMO talent that helps enterprise-AI startups avoid scaling mistakes; open to a quick intro?

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 31 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

5U AI

heat 74

Trigger: $3.2M pre-seed led by Emerge Capital - Tech.eu, as of 28 Jul 2026

Why now: Munich logistics-AI startup building a digital workforce platform for freight forwarding just raised pre-seed; early-stage B2B SaaS in exactly the target band, needing first marketing/dev/design hires.

Who to contact: Founder / CEO

Angle: Congrats on the Emerge-led pre-seed - freight-forwarding buyers are notoriously skeptical of AI; I help logistics SaaS craft proof-led messaging for their first design partners, want to compare notes?

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 31 — the signal decays within weeks.

Who to contact: Head of Marketing / VP Growth

Angle: Positioning as the neutral 'Switzerland' of telematics is a sharp story - I help data-marketplace startups turn a positioning line into a repeatable demand engine; can I send a short teardown?

Who to contact: Co-founder / CEO

Angle: Second act after the Cisco/Epsagon exit is always about speed - I help proven founders spin up enterprise demand-gen before the product is fully GA; happy to share what worked for similar teams.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 31 — the signal decays within weeks.

Who to contact: Founder / CEO

Angle: Congrats on the Superhero-led pre-seed - going pan-European early means your messaging has to survive multiple markets; I help vertical SaaS localize GTM without diluting the pitch, worth 20 minutes?

heat 58

Trigger: $3.5M seed to help construction firms find and win projects - TechCrunch, as of 22 Jul 2026

Why now: (unverified) Early-stage B2B SaaS for construction lead-gen closed a seed round; single thin source and slightly older, but a genuine target-band trigger needing first growth/marketing hires.

Who to contact: Founder / CEO

Angle: Congrats on the seed - construction buyers respond to referrals and proof, not generic ads; I help vertical SaaS build outbound that lands with contractors, open to a quick call?

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 31 — the signal decays within weeks.
